newsitem.title: USA: ICTS buys U.S. airport security firm.
newsitem.headline: ICTS buys U.S. airport security firm.

text.p: Netherlands-based ICTS International NV said on Tuesday that it acquired an 82.5 percent interest in Service Service Inc, a privately-owned provider of passenger check-in services to American Airlines at Chicago's O'Hare Airport.
ICTS offers enhanced aviation security services, serving mostly European operations of U.S. carriers, the company said.

The Service Service acquisition was for about $700,000 of cash and notes and marks ICTS's first acquisition in the United States, the company said. In 1996, Service Service had revenues of approximately $2 million, the company said.

Also, ICTS said it signed an agreement for security consulting services with InVision Technologies Inc to provide management and executive services, mainly to U.S. air carriers and airport authorities to support InVision's explosives detection devices.
